newsitem.title: USA: Monterey Pasta chief executive resigns.
newsitem.headline: Monterey Pasta chief executive resigns.

text.p: Monterey Pasta Co said Friday that Norman Dean resigned as president and chief executive officer.

It said that the board of directors also accepted the resignation of three board members: Christopher Gillam, Paul Miller and Mike Moone. It said they were formerly associates of Dean at the Nestle Beverage Co.
The company gave no reason for the departures, but said in a statement it was committed "to increasing its rate of growth and achieving profitability."
At the end of August, the company, which makes and distributes fresh refrigerated pasta and sauce, said it expected to report continuing losses in its third quarter to September 30.
On Friday, the company said a search firm will be retained to assist with efforts to find a new president.

It said the board of directors appointed Marshall Stevens as senior vice president and interim president. He will report to a three-member operating committee to be chaired by Charles Bonner, a board member and president of Pacific Resources Co in Fresno, California.
"In our search for a new president, we will focus on hiring someone that will add value to both," the statement said.
